arguments.sql: SELECT substr(date, 1, 10) AS day, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions GROUP BY day ORDER BY n DESC, day ASC LIMIT 1
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions per calendar day and returns the day with the highest count, with that count.
assumptions: Calendar day taken from the date text (YYYY-MM-DD part), covering all transactions from 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
All transactions counted, including those without a fraud label and those with negative amounts.
If several days tie for the top count, the earliest day is returned.
